edges.reason: onlyOnTurn modifier compares msg.sender to currentResponder() to gate the turn
clearChallenge requires msg.sender == address(resultReceiver) before destroying the challenge
_asserter parameter is written into the asserter state variable during initialization
_challenger parameter is written into the challenger state variable during initialization
_executionHash parameter initializes the challengeState merkle root
_executionHash becomes the initial challengeState
_challengedSegmentLength drives chunk hash computation and segment bounds checks
_challengedSegmentStart is used to build the bisection hash and new root
newChallengeState local is assigned into the challengeState state variable
lastMoveBlock is subtracted from the current block to derive timeSinceLastMove
timeSinceLastMove is compared against currentResponderTimeLeft to allow timeout
timeout decision depends on block based timing, a validator influenceable value
onlyOnTurn deadline enforcement relies on block based timing comparisons
asserterTimeLeft is read when computing the current responder's deadline
challengerTimeLeft is read when computing the current responder's deadline
prover parameter indexes into executors to select the external executor call target
executors array element is invoked via executeStep external call
resultReceiver state variable is the target of the completeChallenge external call
rootHash local is verified against challengeState to gate one step proof completion
initializeChallenge writes challengeState and locks the initialization guard
oneStepProveExecution makes an external call to an attacker selected executor
_asserterWin performs an external call into resultReceiver.completeChallenge
_challengerWin performs an external call into resultReceiver.completeChallenge
_asserterWin ends execution through safeSelfDestruct
_challengerWin ends execution through safeSelfDestruct
clearChallenge destroys the clone via safeSelfDestruct
_currentWin calls _asserterWin when turn is Asserter
_currentWin calls _challengerWin otherwise
oneStepProveExecution invokes _currentWin after a valid proof
proveContinuedExecution invokes _currentWin after proving continuation
timeout calls _asserterWin when the challenger times out
timeout calls _challengerWin when the asserter times out
_challengedSegmentStart drives bisection hash and bound checks in proveContinuedExecution
